findings.title: Task 4 Step 16 still carries the old conditional git-add note for duelRecord.ts
findings.claim: Step 16's `git add` now always lists `src/renderer/src/net/duelRecord.ts` and `tests/duelInput.test.ts`. The note below it still reads "(Add src/renderer/src/net/duelRecord.ts and any fake-pointer test file if Steps 4 or 13 changed them.)". That is a leftover of the conditional that R1-F7 removed, and it contradicts the self-review line saying no step depends on how a sibling turned out.
findings.evidence: plan Task 4 Step 16, git add line (now includes net/duelRecord.ts and tests/duelInput.test.ts) and the parenthetical directly after the commit block; plan Self-review 'Placeholders' line (L2463)
findings.why: It is harmless, but it tells executors to probe for a change that Step 13 now always makes.
findings.fix: Delete the parenthetical. If other fake PointerSource objects outside tests/duelInput.test.ts get `leftHeld`, name those files explicitly instead.
